facts.text: The Bachelor of Arts in Architecture requires 180 quarter credits, combining professional architecture coursework with 60 credits of integrative studies to prepare students for a master's degree or entry-level architectural roles.

sources.title: Bachelor of Arts in Architecture - NewSchool of Architecture & Design
sources.quote: With a total of 180 quarter credits, the program offers a comprehensive blend of required and elective professional credits, ensuring a breadth of knowledge in architectural practices, alongside 60 integrative studies credits to foster a well-rounded education.
